Large need, low price point What families pay today Alarm wristband: about 20–55 zł a month, plus 299–999 zł for the device. Voice check-in service: listed at 149 zł a month. National 2026 budget for remote care devices: 20 million zł. We pitch Krąg as an experience, not yet as a business. 37.5% of Wrocław residents find care hard to get Wrocław Social Diagnosis 2025 7.9M people in Poland are 65 or over Statistics Poland, 2025 1.9M of them live alone Estimate, EU labour survey 2020
She talks to one person What she sees She talks only to Krąg, by voice or a simple tap. She can start voice mode herself in the 1:1 chat and speak as she would to a neighbour. A companion, not a dashboard. Behind the conversation Five more agents work quietly behind Krąg. Family stays outside the app. A prototype of the experience, not an alarm or medical service.
A morning in her chair What she hears this morning Weather: 2°C and fog in Wrocław (IMGW). Name day: today is Marek’s. Morning tablet: biała, jedna, as on the prescription. A family photo may arrive from Ania or Marek. For later: “Jak wyglądała Pani droga do szkoły?” Demo morning · DemoTablet · invented family, simulated photo One check-in One warm conversation, not a dashboard of alerts. Voice mode She can say it out loud, in the same 1:1 chat.
01 Krąg The only bot she talks to: companion voice and care. 02 Informator Morning brief: weather, air, name days, public facts. 03 Rodzina Links relatives outside the app (simulated sends in the demo). 04 Kronika One memoir question a day. Never invents her past. 05 Apteczka Tablet times and stock. Never advises on medicine. 06 Strażnik Every outbound message needs approval before it reaches her or the family. Six agents, one goal People and agents, working toward one shared goal: her day going well. She only ever sees Krąg.
Prototype, not an alarm A care circle you can talk to — not another alarm on the wrist. Working prototype on Grok Bot: six agents and a care-team group. She only sees Krąg. Theme fit: Multiplayer AI / Multi-agent Systems — people plus AI toward a shared goal.
